article_title: Skye Newman gets 'goosebumps' over record-breaking Brixton Academy run

tasks.prompt: What is the report mainly about?
options: Skye Newman's record-breaking five-night run at Brixton Academy
A new music school opening in south London
The cancellation of Harry Styles's Australian tour
Little Simz releasing five singles in November
tasks.correct_answer: Skye Newman's record-breaking five-night run at Brixton Academy
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת ברצף של חמש הופעות של סקיי ניומן בבריקסטון אקדמי, שיא לאמנית סולו בריטית.

tasks.prompt: Whose previous record at Brixton Academy did Newman overtake?
options: Ella Henderson's two nights
Little Simz's three nights
Amy Winehouse's four nights
Ed Sheeran's six nights
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ליטל סימז הופיעה שלושה לילות במקום בשנת 2021, וניומן עקפה את השיא עם חמש הופעות.

tasks.prompt: Which single reached number five in June?
options: Addicted
Hairdresser
Family Matters
Back to Black
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסינגל Family Matters הגיע למקום החמישי ביוני, לאחר ש-Hairdresser נכנס לעשרים הגדולים.

tasks.prompt: When Newman calls her coming Harry Styles support slots “surreal”, what does she mean?
options: They were arranged in secret
They feel strangely unbelievable
They will use unusual stage effects
They have already been cancelled
tasks.explanation_hebrew: surreal בהקשר הזה פירושו מצב שנראה כמעט לא אמיתי, במיוחד משום שהייתה מעריצה של One Direction בילדותה.

tasks.prompt: Why did Newman perform Amy Winehouse's “Addicted” during the show?
options: To celebrate the anniversary of the album Back to Black
To announce a duet with Elton John
To audition a new member of her band
To replace a song requested by Ed Sheeran
tasks.correct_answer: To celebrate the anniversary of the album Back to Black
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביצוע היה מחווה לאיימי ויינהאוס לציון יום השנה לאלבום Back to Black.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “big shoes to fill”, what is Newman expressing?
options: She needs new footwear for the tour
She wants to copy Winehouse's clothes
Matching Winehouse's artistic legacy is a major challenge
The Brixton stage is too large for one performer
tasks.correct_answer: Matching Winehouse's artistic legacy is a major challenge
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי big shoes to fill מתאר את הקושי לעמוד ברמה או במורשת של אדם מצליח ומוערך מאוד.

tasks.prompt: Why does Newman describe putting women on stage with her as both symbolic and practical?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את המסר של נראות נשית ואת יצירת ההזדמנויות התעסוקתיות בפועל.
expected_points: She says women are central to her life
The stage gives women visible roles in the performance
Hiring them also provides jobs and a practical helping hand

tasks.prompt: Summarise the milestones that show Newman's rapid rise in the music industry.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול הישגים במצעדים, הכרה מקצועית, הופעות בולטות והשיא בבריקסטון.
expected_points: Her first two singles both reached the UK top 20
She won BBC Sound of 2026 and received a Brit Award nomination
She supported Ed Sheeran and Lewis Capaldi and was praised by Elton John
She became the first British female solo artist to headline five nights at Brixton Academy

tasks.prompt: Why are the Australian shows with Harry Styles especially meaningful to Newman?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין חוויית הילדות שלה כמעריצה לבין ההזדמנות המקצועית הנוכחית.
expected_points: She was a One Direction fan as a child
Harry Styles was part of One Direction
She will now support him at shows in Australia
The change from fan to fellow performer makes the opportunity feel surreal

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining how Newman uses her success to honour influences and support other women.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב דוגמה למחווה מוזיקלית ודוגמה לתמיכה מעשית בנשים.
expected_points: She paid tribute to Amy Winehouse by performing Addicted
The tribute marked the anniversary of Back to Black
She performs with an all-female band
She says employing women provides jobs and gives them a helping hand
